title: The WCCW book club:
title_short: WCCW book club · Take Our Name Back
headline: What a room full of readers sounds like: a name and a culture taken back, a language worth saving, a book full of hearts in the margins, and a library on the house.
story: A music-led group cut from the WCCW book club. It is texture, not a lecture: short lines from the room, the readers' own words, and the books in their hands.

Arc: a reader talks about taking a name and a culture back, another says Native American culture and its language are endangered, then the room lightens with a traded book full of notes, and it ends on the library: “The library is on the house.” Speakers are not named.
do: Open on “take our culture back, take our name and our land back”, with <q>Take our name back</q> already on screen.
Music leads. Bring the lines up over it as texture. Captions carry the words: the room is echoey.
Make the book trade (P1055379 00:30 to 00:56) the visual centerpiece: the annotated copy, the notes in the margins.
Facility line at 00:03: Washington Corrections Center for Women. No name cards.
End on the library line, then the end card.
dont: Never use P1055378.MOV. It is Minnesota and looks like it belongs.
Do not use “I hate it here.” (P1055379 01:15.5 and 01:17.5) or the line about facility rules (01:41.7).
No name cards. Speakers are not named.
No B-roll shot that Samantha's “A Book About Censorship” cut uses.
